name: Node.js
covers: 32 eslint-plugin-n rules ported to Rerail, 6 of them on and 26 off until turned on, each scored against eslint-plugin-n's own findings on its test cases and on real-code samples.

rules.title: eslint-plugin-n callback-return: Require `return` statements after callbacks
eslint-plugin-n exports-style: Enforce either `module.exports` or `exports`
eslint-plugin-n global-require: Require `require()` calls to be placed at top-level module scope
eslint-plugin-n handle-callback-err: Require error handling in callbacks
eslint-plugin-n hashbang: Require correct usage of hashbang
eslint-plugin-n no-callback-literal: Enforce Node.js-style error-first callback pattern is followed
eslint-plugin-n no-deprecated-api: Disallow deprecated APIs
eslint-plugin-n no-exports-assign: Disallow the assignment to `exports`
eslint-plugin-n no-mixed-requires: Disallow `require` calls to be mixed with regular variable declarations
eslint-plugin-n no-new-require: Disallow `new` operators with calls to `require`
eslint-plugin-n no-path-concat: Disallow string concatenation with `__dirname`, `__filename`, and `import.meta` paths
eslint-plugin-n no-process-env: Disallow the use of `process.env`
eslint-plugin-n no-process-exit: Disallow the use of `process.exit()`
eslint-plugin-n no-sync: Disallow synchronous methods
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/buffer: Enforce either `Buffer` or `require("buffer").Buffer`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/console: Enforce either `console` or `require("console")`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/process: Enforce either `process` or `require("process")`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/text-decoder: Enforce either `TextDecoder` or `require("util").TextDecoder`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/text-encoder: Enforce either `TextEncoder` or `require("util").TextEncoder`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/url: Enforce either `URL` or `require("url").URL`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/url-search-params: Enforce either `URLSearchParams` or `require("url").URLSearchParams`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-node-protocol: Enforce using the `node:` protocol when importing Node.js builtin modules
eslint-plugin-n prefer-promises/dns: Enforce `require("dns").promises`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-promises/fs: Enforce `require("fs").promises`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/crypto: enforce either `crypto` or `require("crypto").webcrypto`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-global/timers: enforce either global timer functions or `require("timers")`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-import/assert-strict: enforce using `node:assert/strict` instead of `node:assert`
eslint-plugin-n prefer-process-get-builtin-module: enforce using `process.getBuiltinModule()` to load Node.js built-in modules
eslint-plugin-n no-unsupported-features/node-builtins: disallow unsupported Node.js built-in APIs on the specified version
eslint-plugin-n no-unsupported-features/es-builtins: disallow unsupported ECMAScript built-ins on the specified version
eslint-plugin-n no-top-level-await: disallow top-level `await` in published modules
eslint-plugin-n no-unpublished-bin: disallow `bin` files that npm ignores
